newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends higher ahead of PORLA.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends higher ahead of PORLA.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market traded sideways for the greater part of the day, before closing steadier ahead of official PORLA January crop data on Saturday. Speculative buying and bargain hunting were seen at lower levels. May futures contract held steady at between 1,289 and 1,301.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Dealing was seen among nearby crude palm oil and prices were generally higher in line with futures.
"We expect PORLA to announce more friendly numbers which should underpin sentiment next week," the trader said.
The market extended late Thursday's gains on covering after falling earlier on news that India's proposal of an increase in import duty on edible oil to 30 from 20 percent.
"There was very little interest and trading was cautious with people just waiting for leads," a trader said, adding that some players were away celebrating the last day of Lunar New Year festival.
"Some profit-taking appeared at the higher levels while bargain hunting was seen at lower side," a trader said.
Third month May futures closed 12 ringgit higher at 1,301 ringgit ($524.91) a tonne.
There were some shortcovering and spread trading activity, traders said. Turnover was 2,478 lots.
Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,347.50 ringgit against bids of 1,345 with earlier trades at 1,340 and 1,345.
Feb (central) saw offers at 1,350 and bids at 1,345 and Feb (north) at 1,350 against 1,335.
